Panel two, the accident: the elevator doors suddenly open, she stops abruptly and loses her balance, leaning slightly backward with her arms spread and a startled expression. The phone slips into the air beside her face, the coffee cup leaves her hand in front of her waist, and the badge lanyard slips completely off her head, with the badge and lanyard briefly airborne together. Keep the three props clearly separated, capturing a real action instant with high-speed photography. Panel three, phone close-up: the orange phone tilts and rotates in the foreground with its back facing the camera, her startled face blurred behind it. Use shallow depth of field and realistic lighting, conveying movement only through the phone's orientation and her gaze, without graphics. Panel four, coffee close-up: a low-angle close-up shows the tilted cup approaching the front of her raised right shoe, its lid still attached, with a few coffee droplets frozen near the drinking opening by a fast shutter. Clearly show the cup base, shoe surface, and gap between them, with floor tiles blurred behind. Panel five, badge close-up: the badge and dark blue lanyard are airborne in the foreground, the lanyard naturally curved. Her extended left hand is behind them, with her wrist approaching the lanyard loop and her face blurred in the background. The lanyard is a physical object with real thickness, woven texture, and shadows. Include no readable name or company logo. Panel six, full-body balance shot: she supports her weight on her left leg and begins raising her right, spreading both arms to regain balance and tracking the falling objects with her gaze. The phone is above her right thigh, the coffee cup is near her right foot, and the badge is near her left wrist. Convey bodily control through realistic posture, muscle tension, clothing folds, and natural shadows. Her legs have ordinary opaque skin with a natural appearance. Panel seven, precision catch climax: a full-body three-quarter side view shows her securely balanced on her left leg, her right thigh raised almost horizontally, her lower leg hanging naturally downward, and her right toe slightly lifted. The phone lies flat across her right thigh, the coffee cup stands upright in actual contact with and supported by the front of her right shoe, and the lanyard loops around her raised left wrist with the badge hanging naturally below. She looks down with concentration to check the objects. Make all contact points and support relationships clearly visible. Panel eight, returning the objects to her hands: a full-body shot shows her using a small upward movement of her right leg to send the phone and coffee back toward her hands. The phone is above her right hand and the coffee above her left, both hands open to catch their respective objects. The badge remains around her left wrist, and she smiles with relief. Capture the brief airborne instant. Panel nine, composed finish: a medium close-up shows her standing securely again, presenting the recovered phone screen toward the camera in her right hand and holding coffee in her left, with the badge lanyard still around her left wrist. She smiles calmly, the screen displays a simple abstract profile-page layout, and the elevator lobby is softly blurred behind her. Each panel contains only the same woman, one phone, one coffee cup, and one badge, with each prop appearing only once in its current shot position, without duplicates, ghosting, or superimposed successive poses.
